title: T105 (Tinyana) PNC - Chiddushei Torah — Tikkun for Hirhurim, and Good for the Nishmas Avoisecha
hebrewTitle: חידושי תורה — תיקון להרהורים וטובה לנשמת אבותיו
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **Shamati me-echad, she-hizhir oso, she-yishtadel le-ayein be-Toraso ve-yiraeh le-chadeish be-Toraso eizeh dovor (ka-asher hizhir al zeh le-chammah ve-chammah mei-anashav).** Rabbeinu *exhorted* one of the anashim *to look in his Toirah and to try to be mechadeish a dovor in Toirah*. **Ve-amar lo: im tizkeh le-chavein el toichen kavanasi be-Toirasi — mah toiv. Ve-afilu im loi tuchal le-chavein kavanasi, af-al-pi-chein toiv me'oid ke-she-zoichin le-chadeish eizeh dovor be-Torah — ki hu tikkun gadol le-hirhurim.** Two registers of *to'eles*: (a) *kavein kavanas Rabbeinu* — *mah toiv*; (b) but *even when one cannot* — *to be mechadeish anything at all in Toirah is itself a tikkun gadol for hirhurim*. **Ki kol ha-hirhurim ba'im al-yedei koach ha-medameh, ve-al-yedei she-mechadshin eizeh dovor be-Torah — she-zehu bechinas medameh milsa le-milsa — al-yedei zeh mesakenin pegam ha-hirhurim she-ba'in al-yedei ha-medameh.** *Chiddush be-Toirah* is the *medameh milsa le-milsa* of *kedushah* — and that re-channels the very *koach ha-medameh* that, when broken, manufactured the hirhurim.

intermediate.en: **Yesoid**: *Rabbeinu hizhir le-chadeish be-Toirah*. Im yachoil le-chavein kavanas Rabbeinu — *mah toiv*; im loi — *afilu chiddush kol-she-hu hu tikkun gadol le-hirhurim*. **Mechanism**: *kol ha-hirhurim ba'in al-yedei koach ha-medameh*; *chiddush be-Torah = medameh milsa le-milsa* (medameh shel kedushah) → *mesakein pegam ha-medameh*.

scholarly.he: [T2:105א] חידושי תורה = תיקון להרהורים, כי "כל ההרהורים באים ע"י כח המדמה" וחידוש בתורה = "מדמה מילתא למילתא" = מתיקון המדמה.

beginner.en: **Gam Reb Nosson shama be-atzmoi mi-piv ha-kadoish kammah ve-chammah pe'amim, she-hizhir me'oid le-chadeish be-Torah, ve-amar she-hu tikkun gadol me'oid me'oid al he-avar.** Reb Nosson testifies: he himself heard *kammah pe'amim* — *tikkun gadol me'oid me'oid al he-avar*. *Va-amar she-afilu dibbur echad le-vad ke-she-zoichin le-chadeish — hu gam-kein toiv me'oid, ki hu tikkun gadol me'oid.* **Even one dibbur of chiddush is a tikkun gadol**. **Gam amar she-hu toivah le-nishmas avoisav, she-kvar nis-talku** (see Zoihar Shelach 171 ve-174 and Zoihar Chadash Rus). Reading and being mechadeish in Toirah is *not* a private avoidah — it is *toivah le-nishmas avoisav she-kvar nis-talku*; the chiddush *reaches* into shamayim *for the parents and grandparents* of the one who learned.

intermediate.en: **Reb Nosson mi-piv ha-kadoish**: hizhir le-chadeish be-Toirah → *tikkun gadol me'oid me'oid al he-avar*. *Afilu dibbur echad ke-she-mechadeish — toiv me'oid*. **Hosafah niftolah**: *toivah le-nishmas avoisav she-kvar nis-talku* (זוה"ק שלח קעא; קעד; זוהר חדש רות).

scholarly.he: [T2:105ב] אפילו דיבור אחד של חידוש = תיקון גדול על העבר. טובה לנשמת אבותיו (זוה"ק שלח קעא; קעד; זוה"ח רות).
